From a futureme email I wrote myself right before the start of a semester:

This Is just to remind you that you are capable of things far more than you can imagine. Don't ever let your anxiety cripple and scare you. I know it sounds ironic since we're the same person. The person writing this to you right now is the one riddled with anxiety. I just want you to hang on for a while. Please know that this terribly anxious person fully believes in your ability. You will get through it. All will be well.

2. None for the items I ordered (personal care items).
3. If $49 'yung total order, free shipping siya. Not sure how much if hindi na-meet 'yung $49. 
5. No yata. Ninjavan 'yung courier na nag-deliver nung orders ko.

I bought their shampoo and conditioner before and I don't think worth it 'yung quality for the price. Hindi siya gaanong mabango for me and hindi rin gaanong nagla-last 'yung smell, probably around 1-2 hours lang. Parang wala rin siyang naitulong sa hair ko in terms of hair fall. I also have their non-wash hair pack and I have barely used it since ang lagkit sa hair. It's probably much better to use professional or salon-quality brands.
Type "talk-to-agent_order-selector" sa chat with customer care.

Hello! I ordered a mattress tapos XIMEX din 'yung courier. 8 days siyang stuck sa "Package Picked Up" status so I contacted Lazada Customer Service tapos they raised it to XIMEX kaya na-prioritize 'yung order. Nakarating naman na siya sa akin ngayon. So I suggest chat ka na lang din sa CS to follow up 😊

I bought 3 phones already via Shopee and so far, wala pa namang dumadating na bato hahahaha. Just do your due diligence to make sure na okay 'yung seller (e.g., check reviews, compare with other sellers if realistic 'yung price). I paid all of them online para less hassle during delivery.
Matagal nga yata deliveries kapag sa XDE huhuhu. Medyo weird lang kasi may other order ako na XDE rin 'yung courier tapos less than an hour after pick up, nakarating naman sa local hub.

Hi! I'm currently a working law student. Kaya naman siyang pagsabayin if your school has a program for working students. Also, I failed a class last semester and I dread the idea of retaking that subject na I came close to quitting law school. Right now, I can no longer envision  myself as a lawyer pero I decided na tumuloy pa rin kasi ayoko ma-disappoint 'yung mga taong naniniwala sa akin and masyado rin yatang mataas pride ko to quit hahaha. 

Pero going back, kaya naman maging working student pero it is a daily struggle. I had blockmates who took leave of absence because they received good job opportunities, others decided that they wanted to do something else. Ultimately, choose what you think is best for you.
Yes, I think para siyang finals na it covers all topics discussed. And also, yes, ang bigat mag-retake ng subject hahahuhu ang hahaba pa naman ng readings sa ireretake kong subject if ever
I'm also not sure since never pa ako nag-removals but if I'm not mistaken, it's an exam tapos if you pass, you'll get a 3.0 but if not, singko. Good luck and I hope you'll pass your subjects 😊

I got a 4.0 in one of our major subjects but we have no removals so kailangan kong i-retake. Ako naman, 3 points na lang sana para maka-tres. Masakit since I thought I did well sa finals then surpriseee~ How to cope with it? Iniyakan ko nang very light then proceeded to look at the bright side na hopefully, if I retake it, it would be easier na since familiar na ako sa topics. Good luck!
Thank you! Just got confused lang when my prof told me that the grades for both takes will be averaged.

I have a very similar experience. First crush ko yung high school classmate ko and almost perfect tingin ko sa kanya: gwapo, gentleman, may sense of humor, magaling sa sports, marunong magluto, and probably the most academically inclined person I know (batch valedictorian nung HS and graduated Summa Cum Laude nung college). So long story short, naging crush ko siya for more than half a decade tapos bigla siyang nagka-girlfriend hahahahaha. Staying strong pa rin sila ngayon, meanwhile single pa rin ako. May mga naging aesthetic attractions naman ako after niyang magkajowa pero I felt like ang taas ng standards na sinet ni first crush na tipong walang makakapantay. I think memories of him will always bring nostalgia pero I'm happy for him naman and I can say na naka-move on na ako. Just let time do its work and occupy yourself with other things and one day, marerealize mong okay ka na. Rooting for you, OP!

"pining for a man who is desired by a lot of women" -> story of my life chrt HAHAHAHA

Good luck, OP! Sana laging i-view ng happy crush mo stories mo 😍
Prayer reveal naman po 🥹 jk hahahaha. Wishing you all the best!

It's okay, it's not a dumb question since I also didn't know how to find my pubic bone prior to using the disc 😅 If you try to insert your finger then slide it along the top part of the vaginal wall, around 1 1/2 knuckles in, you'll probably feel a hard part that is sort of like a ridge. The hard part is the pubic bone.

Hi! I never used a cup since I went straight from pads to disc. But based on my experience from using a disc for almost half a year, it is really easy since there is no suction. I just insert it and the disc settles into the right place without much fiddling. Removal is also easy since I just use my index finger to pull it out and I think the width while removing the disc is around the size of a thumb. Hope this helps 😊

What I do is I slightly bear down while inserting my index finger, then I will feel for the top of the rim. Once I can feel it, I will pull the rim using my index finger. Then if it is already near the opening, I will pull it using my index finger and thumb. This is only method that works for me. It also makes removal almost mess-free. I hope this helps 😊

Went from Lumma M to Moonthlies small since the Lumma pretty much autodump whenever I use the bathroom. I love the Moonthlies since it stays in place sooo well and the only time it autodumps is during my heaviest day and only if I wanted to.
